title: Canon of the Hawk and Black Azure
summary: A canon of plunging dark strokes and wing-wide guards that darkens the sky above the foe and ends in a fall from above.

title: Twin-Court Treatise of Absolute Dim
summary: A treatise on two courts of dark that dim and then judge the foe so that the paired verdict lands as one stroke.

title: The Basin of Shadow Mastery
summary: A mastery of gathering darkness like water in a basin and pouring it out over the rim in one overwhelming flood.

title: Canon of the River of Lightless Qi
summary: A canon of dark qi run as a river with its eddies and its pull that carries the foe off his feet and under.

title: Compendium of the Paired Umbra
summary: A compendium of a second shadow cast beside the first so that the user acts from two places and the foe fights a double.

title: The Wind-Sworn Oath of the Unseen Bearing
summary: A sworn manual of travelling on a heading no eye can follow and of striking from the point where the heading ends.

title: Manual of the Unwalled Eclipse
summary: A manual of an eclipse thrown open over a broad ground that offers no cover and strips every concealment from those beneath it.

title: A Reckoning of Quenched Lights
summary: A reckoning of every way to put out a flame or glow or lamp of qi and the dark that follows when the last light fails.

title: The Oath of the Absorbing Bearing
summary: A sworn manual of taking blows and light into the dark along a held heading and giving nothing back until the oath is called.

title: Plain Canon of Concealment Past Sensing
summary: A plain canon on hiding the body so well that even trained qi sense passes over it and finds only empty air.
